So, \( n \) can take any integer value from 0 to 5994. The number of integers in this range is \( 5994 - 0 + 1 = 5995 \).

Thus, the number of positive integers \( n \leq 1000 \) that can be expressed in the form \(\lfloor x \rfloor + \lfloor 2x \rfloor + \lfloor 3x \rfloor = n\) is \(\boxed{5995}\).
